name: Mi Quang
summary: Wide, flat, chewy turmeric noodles with a small ladle of broth, less liquid than phở and big on flavour. Pork, chicken, shrimp, or a mix may sit in the bowl, finished with herbs, peanuts, and a crispy rice cracker.
origin: Quảng Nam, and one night program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn on 24 Mar 2022.
texture: The noodles are wide, flat, and chewy, and the noodles and the broth are turmeric-yellow.
taste: There is less broth than in phở, and the ladle is big on flavour. Chili, lime, and soy sauce are there if you want them.
howToEat: Toss the noodles with the herbs and the ladle of broth.
Pork, chicken, shrimp, or a mix may be in the bowl, and quail eggs or pork sausage may be too.
It finishes with crispy rice crackers and peanuts.
where: A program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn, xã Duy Phú, began at 16:00 on 24 Mar 2022 and served mì Quảng. On 1 Dec 2025 Tuổi Trẻ quotes the deputy in charge saying the night calendar is not fixed.
The ticket rules forbid eating in the monument area.
Vietnam Tourism describes the bowl across Quảng Nam: flat turmeric noodles, a ladle of broth, and pork, chicken, shrimp, or a mix, with rice crackers, herbs, and peanuts.
seoTitle: Mi Quang — wide turmeric noodles and a small ladle
seoDescription: Wide turmeric noodles with a small ladle of broth, herbs, peanuts, and a rice cracker. A night program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn served the bowl on 24 Mar 2022.
